quest.title: An Official Mission
quest.description: You meet two seemingly troubled Fontainians in Natlan...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: This place is positively sweltering... I'm starting to miss the cold drinks back at the Maison.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Mr. Roialte, I am still struggling to see why our office was the one selected for an official delegation to Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Shouldn't business affairs be handled by a department with a more specific trade mandate?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: You're absolutely right, young man. Those in charge of trade will do the actual "handling" of this matter — we are only here to make "preliminary contact."

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Goodness! Couldn't they just come here themselves, then? It's not as if that lot does anything useful most days. You know, apart from considering how to export Rainbow Roses in bulk at absurd markups!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Ah, the Rainbow Rose exports... That is one of their primary tasks, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Be that as it may, they've been "considering" it over for three whole months this year. Just like they do every year, in fact!

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: And the results of their "careful consideration"? They simply decided to find another time next year to give the matter another three months' "consideration"!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Well, it is a matter that is worth careful consideration. It is related to our department's work, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I'll be frank, it seems to me that the one thing they do do, is do their best not to do anything at all.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Hahahaha, precisely! And if everyone was like that, then we Gestionnaires would have some peace and quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: So, now do you understand why we were the ones the Maison sent to establish preliminary contact?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: No, sir, I do not. All I see is our office's seal on this notice — and only ours!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Oh dearie me, and isn't it our office that has a most enthusiastic and capable young man on staff?

choices.text: Wait, you're Iaune!

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: #Why, {NICKNAME}! Dunk me in the Fountain and call me a fulmar, it's really you!

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: #Haha! Well, well, if it isn't our favorite {M#good-hearted fellow}{F#kind-hearted lady}.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: See now, lad, do I not say that fair weather is never far from the optimist?

choices.text: I see you two were having a lively discussion.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Indeed we were! Ample discussion is necessary prior to progressing any task.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Though as you may have surmised... our progress has not been ideal.

choices.text: What are you two doing here, exactly?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: In truth, our work here in Natlan is to find out "what work there is to do."

choices.text: Ah, now that's the Maison Gestion I know.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Simply put, we were sent to look for opportunities for collaboration, be they in trade, travel... or whatever else.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: So long as we can find something for the gentlemen back at the Maison to busy themselves with, we shall have succeeded.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: We haven't even any leads at the moment, though. *sigh* Never mind everything else, we haven't even found a single proper contact.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: #Ah, but now we have. Do you know the person in charge here, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Erm... the Pyro Archon?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Uhhh...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: That... stands to reason.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: *cough* Anyway... Natlan is a nation of many tribes, so there must always be many matters to attend to in meetings. As for the venue for such meetings...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That would be here.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Alright. In that case, where may we find an office that oversees business affairs here, so that we may submit our official documentation there?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Besides, I believe that matters of trade between two nations require a formal coordination committee to be convened. We must put a list of participants together as soon as possible.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You can discuss it with people from each of the various tribes.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Uhm, do you... mean to say that there are no overall administrative offices, offices responsible for individual industries, or intermediate departments that transmit and issue tasks here?

choices.text: Things just aren't that difficult around here.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: On the contrary, this could make things far more difficult...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: *sigh* Very well, then, I guess that's just how things are. If nothing else, those in our office specialize in accepting present realities that cannot be changed.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Come on then, lad, time we got to work. We'll do a round, visit each of the tribes in turn and see if there are any business opportunities to be had.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: #Dear {NICKNAME}, could we ask you to show us the way once more?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: There will be no need to worry about compensation. The Maison has granted us a sizable discretionary expense account. I'm sure we can come to an arrangement that will leave a smile on your face.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: That's the silver lining. Were we in Fontaine, it could take a month for a sum this size to find its way to your pocket.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Ha! Only a month? Only if it didn't take any detours along the way!

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: #Alright, back to business. In your opinion, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Which tribe should we visit this time?

choices.text: Or maybe I could just take you guys straight to the Archon?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: I... do not believe that the matter at hand is of sufficient import to warrant such a meeting.

choices.text: We're not in Fontaine anymore, friend. Speak plainly.
Are you here to sell Fonta?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Fonta... I fear such a project would be far beyond the remit of our office.

choices.text: Hmm. Where's Semaine?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Preparing for his wedding, I'm afraid. Shan't be able to extricate himself anytime soon.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: The official notice did state that he was to travel with us — in principle, that is...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Well, I'm sure we can wait a few days for him on dear Ms. Linorea's account.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Till then, you shall have to content yourself with just the two of us engaging in enthusiastic discourse regarding our work.

choices.text: Huh? Why are you guys here?

dialogues.speaker: Yelafath
dialogues.text: Hey there! Want some custom souvenirs? You get to pick your color!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ah, so this is a souvenir store.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Ha! Just as well we came, then.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: It's not every day we come to Natlan on business, so some mementos are a must.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I've also gotten Estelle some gifts. She gave me a beautiful hat previously, and I should like to return the favor.

choices.text: Was it a birthday gift?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: No, no, it wasn't anywhere near my birthday when she gave it to me.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: She caught me that day after I had gotten off work, and before I knew it, she had placed the hat on my head.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: She even said something about spotting it on the way over and thinking it would suit me, so she bought it on the spot.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I was going to thank her and pay her for it, but the moment she heard me mention repayment, she kicked me and stormed off...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: A kick you well deserved, my dear Iaune. If I was not waiting to receive the documentation you are penning in a timely, I too would kick you in the rear right now.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: What!? Sir? Wait, did I guess wrong on the price of the hat? I really didn't mean to insult the hat at all!

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: ...Fine. You just stand right there. I shall kick you once again on Ms. Estelle's behalf.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Just choose a gift already!

response.speaker: Yelafath
response.text: Pfft... O—Oh, ah, sorry! Sorry... Let me help you pick one out, alright?

response.speaker: Yelafath
response.text: What sorts of presents does Ms. Estelle like? Let's start there first.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Hmm... Alright. Blue is her favorite color — not dark, but light blue, best paired with a little yellow.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: She also loves rings. In fact, she sometimes makes them herself, but only wears them while on a break, and never while working.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: And... Ah, yes. The ring cannot be too heavy, because she will sometimes hang it around her neck...

response.speaker: Yelafath
response.text: Oh my, haven't you got an eye for details? Give me a moment. If nothing here works for you, I can do a custom job.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Ah, and don't worry about the price. I shall pay for this gift.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Mr. Roialte...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Oh, shush, young man. Pick your present carefully.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: #Here, take this as payment, {NICKNAME}, as thanks for bringing us here. You have saved more than one life this day.

choices.text: I wish Iaune luck.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Ah, and doesn't he have it in abundance? He'll be fine.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: *sigh* Still, just look at him. I'll have Semaine teach him a thing or two once we get back to Fontaine...

choices.text: I wish Estelle happiness.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: With a lad like Iaune? I imagine our good lady would struggle to be unhappy, if anything.

choices.text: So she just suddenly gave you a gift?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Y—Yes, and unprompted, too. I've wondered why myself...

talks.objective: Listen to the two Fontainians' discussion

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: What's that person up there on the platform doing? Why does he have to climb so high, I wonder?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: He seems to be doing some sort of exercise...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: What sort of exercise would require one to leap off a cliff with a rope tied to oneself? Is this some sort of SSSP training?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: #If my assessment isn't off, he seems to be having quite a grand time, {NICKNAME}...

choices.text: Wanna give it a try?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: #Dear {NICKNAME}, on account of the fact we have yet to finalize your payment, might I ask you not to attempt murder against us?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Just looking at it leaves me deathly faint. If I jumped down... I should develop acrophobia even if I didn't have it already...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: We're counting on you, then — we'd prefer to have a simple meeting in a safe place, where possible.

choices.text: Shall we keep moving forward, then?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Y—Yes... Let's, but could we keep closer to the mountain? I'd prefer not to look over the cliff...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: #Phew... Indeed. If we were to fall, dear {NICKNAME}... I fear you'd have to go back to the Maison Gestion for the remainder of your compensation, given the state we'd be in upon landing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Children of Echoes.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: We'll do as you suggest. Iaune, make sure to keep records. Let's get going.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I will, sir. But... They don't have any official notarized seals that could validate the veracity of the records I make...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Hmm... In that case, we could ask them to sign? Or perhaps use fingerprints as stamps? We'll find a way.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Yes sir, Mr. Roialte...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Scions of the Canopy.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: We'll do as you suggest. Iaune, make sure to keep records. Let's get going.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I will, sir. But... They don't have any official notarized seals that could validate the veracity of the records I make...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Hmm... In that case, we could ask them to sign? Or perhaps use fingerprints as stamps? We'll find a way.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Yes sir, Mr. Roialte...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The People of the Springs.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: We'll do as you suggest. Iaune, make sure to keep records. Let's get going.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I will, sir. But... They don't have any official notarized seals that could validate the veracity of the records I make...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Hmm... In that case, we could ask them to sign? Or perhaps use fingerprints as stamps? We'll find a way.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Yes sir, Mr. Roialte...

talks.objective: Go to the Children of Echoes

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: What is that? A drill? How does it even move?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: "Ask not the springs of why they flow, for since times past has it been so." Just admire the sight, Iaune.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Alright... But I must say that these Children of Echoes have a most unique aesthetic taste...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: #Just so, yes. {NICKNAME}, could you lead us deeper in?

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Hey there. You sure don't look like our tribesfolk — an unusual sight indeed! Are you here for accessories, or for weapons?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Is this... a gemstone? Or a mineral? Simply stunning!

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Are you two from Fontaine? We've got lots of fine ores here! Hmm... Like this blue ore, for instance!

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: But if you want accessories, you'll have to wait a few days, because Master Cheven's going to start from scratch.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Mr. Roialte, what do you think...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Thank you for the most considerate introduction, dear Miss. Forgive me for being presumptuous, but might I inquire who the shop owner is?

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: That's me. Just call me Cheven.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Alright. Ms. Cheven, I am a Gestionnaire, from the Maison Gestion of Fontaine's Palais Mermonia. Would you be interested in signing a partnership agreement to collaborate with us?

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: A partnership agreement? You want to buy accessories, then? Just tell me what you need, and I'll jot it down somewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Wonderful! In that case, let us sign a contract here and now. Did you bring the commercial partnership contracts with you, Iaune?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Yes, sir. This is the commercial partnership agreement, the confidentiality agreement, the notice of obligations, and the partnership certification from our liaison department...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Now then, Ms. Cheven, please sign here, here... and here. Do you have an official seal? A fingerprint will do as well.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Uh... I'm not against doing business. But what's all this about? Are you afraid that I won't honor our agreement?

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Hmph. If I fail to keep my word, you can roll right up to our tribe's land and find me. My shop's not going anywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: You misunderstand, Ms. Cheven. We will also be signing these documents, as the parties responsible for this partnership program.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: However many signatures you sign or fingerprints you press, I will match them one for one.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Hmm? So you don't trust yourself either? With all these records, you'd still lie to yourselves?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Hahaha, you're quite perceptive. I've seen this happen firsthand many times, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: My own professional experience indicates that the person people are best at deceiving is none other than themselves, which is why these documents must be signed by both parties.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Your Fontaine is so strange... Imix, you come have a look at the documentation too, just in case I miss something.

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Ah? Me too?

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Yes, you too. I feel our Fontainian friends here will feel safer the more eyes we have on this "contract" of theirs.

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Eh, um, alright...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: ...Roialte's way with words is something I just can't learn.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: #Let's leave the signing of the contract to them. As for us, {NICKNAME}, let's settle the matter of payment.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: According to our agreement... Here, take this. The amount should be correct.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: W—Wait a minute. I didn't do anything...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: You were present as a trustworthy third party for these business negotiations. That is sufficient.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Were it just the two of us talking business with people here, we might even get a visit from the Maison Gardiennage the instant we got back to Fontaine...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: In any case, just take it. I'm going to collect the documents now.

talks.objective: Go to the Children of Echoes

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Children of Echoes.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Indeed! Let us go, then.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I should've brought a Kamera with me. That way, we could at least have some kind of verifiable record...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Wait, this... is a dance?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: How... expressive. Yes. Leaves quite the impression, too.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Hm, it might be good if we could invite them to perform in Fontaine...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: At the opera house, sir? But...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Of course not. We will find a more suitable venue for these fine gentlemen.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: But before that, let us find the person who leads them... Okay. Hmm. I can't tell who that is.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Um, perhaps we might... Wait for them to finish before asking for further details?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Just so, young man. Let us do that. Ah, but sweet Fountain of Lucine, who knows when they shall finish?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: #Iaune, please give {NICKNAME} {M#his}{F#her} compensation. We wouldn't have found this place without {M#his}{F#her} help, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Or perhaps, we would not have known how to find this tribe at all... Goodness, I feel like I can hardly tell the mountains from the buildings anymore...

talks.objective: Go to the Scions of the Canopy

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Scions of the Canopy.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Indeed! Let us go, then.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I should've brought a Kamera with me. That way, we could at least have some kind of verifiable record...

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Are you here to deliver goods? Hmm? You don't look like you're from around here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They're from Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Really? Now that is unusual...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Uh... Can you really deliver this many letters and packages?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Easily! With the help of our Yumkasaurus friends, no quantity of letters is too much for us to handle!

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Well then, good outlanders? Any letters you'd like to send?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Let me clarify first, though — our manpower's limited, so we'll deliver messages within Natlan, but not beyond its borders.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Err... Might I ask your name, sir?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Michica will do.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Alright then. Mr. Michica, what is the maximum cargo throughput of your facility here?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Cargo throughput? You mean how much stuff we can accommodate?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Come with me. I'll take you on a quick tour of the Courier's Longhouse.

talks.objective: Follow Michica to check out the Courier's Longhouse

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Such a massive space... I'm sure it could hold a huge quantity of merchandise.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Mr. Michica. If you do not mind, I would like to sign a freight contract with you.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Of course, it need not take effect immediately, but I shall need you to leave some storage space and transport personnel free to respond to our shipment needs on an as-and-when basis.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Keep people on standby? Can't do that. Manpower's short, we're struggling to keep up with demand as-is.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: No, no, you needn't worry about that. We will not force you to keep hands idle just on account of a single contract.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: We will also pay in advance for these pre-preparations. Also, if we reach an agreement, further payments will be settled on a monthly basis.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Which is to say that you'll give me the money first, but not have me get to work right away?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Interesting. We can talk details then, but are you guys really okay with paying upfront?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Hahaha, of course. You might actually even consider it a good thing — from a certain point of view.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: But you have my apologies. I did not bring the relevant documents... We shall have to discuss details in the back.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: #My good Iaune, please give {NICKNAME} {M#his}{F#her} compensation. We wouldn't have found this place without {M#his}{F#her} help, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Roialte and Michica head upstairs to discuss the details of their partnership...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: #Good, good, that's one thing that's gone smoothly. Please take these as your payment, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why is paying in advance a good thing?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Well... Roialte often says that a small price paid in advance incentivizes both parties.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: At the very least, it can make the documents and procedures flow faster. The Mora has already been spent, after all.

talks.objective: Go to the Scions of the Canopy
Go to the edge of the platform

dialogues.speaker: Roca
dialogues.text: Welcome, visitors from afar, what brings you here? Up for learning some rock climbing?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Don't look down, don't look down, don't look down...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Blaaargh!

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Ack! Don't scare me like that! I nearly fell there!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Relax, there's no way you'll fall.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm sure that's what everyone who ever slipped and fell thought just before they...

dialogues.speaker: Roca
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Don't worry, I've got my eye on you.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Yes, wonderful... Allow me to rest for a moment. I'd like to talk to you about... offering rock climbing lessons for tourists from Fontaine...

dialogues.speaker: Roca
dialogues.text: Tourists? Do you mean that many Fontainians will come here to learn?

dialogues.speaker: Roca
dialogues.text: Works for me. I've been teaching a Mondstadter to climb. He's a quick learner — he can even handle strong winds nowadays.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: They are very good at dealing with all things wind-related, yes. But please, I beg you, do not expect our Fontainian ladies and gentlemen to climb in driving rain.

dialogues.speaker: Roca
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I wouldn't do that! At most I'd pick a cliff with a pool at the bottom to train them on.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: That would be most excellent. Come, then, let us discuss the details of our potential partnership.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: #My good Iaune, please give {NICKNAME} {M#his}{F#her} compensation. Reaching this place would have proved impossible without {M#his}{F#her} aid, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Roialte and Roca head upstairs to discuss the details of their partnership...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I'd never climb a cliff with naught but a rope, even with a pool beneath me. Absolutely not.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: #Here is your payment, {NICKNAME}. Thank you for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: ...Goodness, I should inch a bit further from this cliff edge. Too high, it is. Far too high...

talks.objective: Go to the People of the Springs

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: The music here is most refreshing. What do you think, Iaune?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Most novel indeed — not even remotely like anything I've heard back home.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: If we could invite them to perform in Fontaine, I imagine the results would be spectacular...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Or perhaps we could bring a band from Fontaine here to perform instead? If we facilitate some collaboration...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: A capital notion! Let me think. Which office would handle that...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, there's an office dedicated to music, too?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: To be precise, it's a newly-established "Association" dedicated to passing on and promoting our traditional music...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Their ranks now boast quite a few Fontainian musicians, and their impact on the industry has been... not insignificant.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: We will need their help should we wish to jumpstart musical collaboration between Fontaine and Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: But the fellow in charge of that office is an exceptionally obstinate cretin. I wonder if he will be able to accept Natlan's music...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: #*sigh* Might as well make a note of it first... Mr. Iaune, do remember to give {NICKNAME} {M#his}{F#her} compensation.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: I'm going backstage to speak to this band. Now then, how shall I start off...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Roialte walks towards the stage, thinking all the while...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I must admit that I find myself quite taken with Natlan's music. It's so lively that one cannot help but want to dance.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, I am not dressed to do so. I absolutely must bring a looser set of clothes the next time I am here.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: #Here is your payment, {NICKNAME}. Thank you for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: ...Ah, yes. The loose clothes aside, I should also bring a nice hat.

talks.objective: Go to the People of the Springs

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: This place is positively sweltering... I'm starting to miss the cold drinks back at the Maison.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Mr. Roialte, I am still struggling to see why our office was the one selected for an official delegation to Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Shouldn't business affairs be handled by a department with a more specific trade mandate?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: You're absolutely right, young man. Those in charge of trade will do the actual "handling" of this matter — we are only here to make "preliminary contact."

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Goodness! Couldn't they just come here themselves, then? It's not as if that lot does anything useful most days. You know, apart from considering how to export Rainbow Roses in bulk at absurd markups!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Ah, the Rainbow Rose exports... That is one of their primary tasks, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Be that as it may, they've been "considering" it over for three whole months this year. Just like they do every year, in fact!

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: And the results of their "careful consideration"? They simply decided to find another time next year to give the matter another three months' "consideration"!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Well, it is a matter that is worth careful consideration. It is related to our department's work, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I'll be frank, it seems to me that the one thing they do do, is do their best not to do anything at all.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Hahahaha, precisely! And if everyone was like that, then we Gestionnaires would have some peace and quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: So, now do you understand why we were the ones the Maison sent to establish preliminary contact?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: No, sir, I do not. All I see is our office's seal on this notice — and only ours!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Oh dearie me, and isn't it our office that has a most enthusiastic and capable young man on staff?

choices.text: You don't look like you're from around here...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Most observant of you! We are Gestionnaires of Fontaine's Maison Gestion. Roialte's my name, and this is Iaune.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #And I'm {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: #Good day to you, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I see you two were having a lively discussion.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Indeed we were! Ample discussion is necessary prior to progressing any task... Especially when said task is not proceeding as expected.

choices.text: What are you two doing here, exactly?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: In truth, our work here in Natlan is to find out "what work there is to do."

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Simply put, we were sent to look for opportunities for collaboration, be they in trade, travel... or whatever else.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: So long as we can find something for the gentlemen back at the Maison to busy themselves with, we shall have succeeded.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: We haven't even any leads at the moment, though. *sigh* Never mind everything else, we haven't even found a single proper contact.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: #But today we have met just such a person. In my view, this {M#good-hearted gentleman}{F#kind-hearted lady} will resolve all the questions that confound us.

choices.text: What questions are those?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: #I shall be direct, then. Dear {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, do you know who is in charge here?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Erm... the Pyro Archon?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Uhhh...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: That... stands to reason.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: *cough* Anyway... Natlan is a nation of many tribes, so there must always be many matters to attend to in meetings. As for the venue for such meetings...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That would be here.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Alright. In that case, where may we find an office that oversees business affairs here, so that we may submit our official documentation there?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Besides, I believe that matters of trade between two nations require a formal coordination committee to be convened. We must put a list of participants together as soon as possible.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You can discuss it with people from each of the various tribes.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Uhm, do you... mean to say that there are no overall administrative offices, offices responsible for individual industries, or intermediate departments that transmit and issue tasks here?

choices.text: Things just aren't that difficult around here.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: On the contrary, this could make things far more difficult...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: *sigh* Very well, then, I guess that's just how things are. If nothing else, those in our office specialize in accepting present realities that cannot be changed.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Come on then, lad, time we got to work. We'll do a round, visit each of the tribes in turn and see if there are any business opportunities to be had.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: #Dear {NICKNAME}, could we ask you to show us the way once more?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: There will be no need to worry about compensation. The Maison has granted us a sizable discretionary expense account. I'm sure we can come to an arrangement that will leave a smile on your face.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: That's the silver lining. Were we in Fontaine, it could take a month for a sum this size to find its way to your pocket.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Ha! Only a month? Only if it didn't take any detours along the way!

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: #Alright, back to business. In your opinion, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Which tribe should we visit this time?

choices.text: Or maybe I could just take you guys straight to the Archon?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: I... do not believe that the matter at hand is of sufficient import to warrant such a meeting.

choices.text: I do know a thing or two about Natlan...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Wonderful!

choices.text: Are you here to sell Fonta?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Fonta... I fear such a project would be far beyond the remit of our office.

choices.text: Fontainians, I presume?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Well then, that was fruitful. Natlan is indeed a marvelous nation, wouldn't you agree, Iaune?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Yes, Mr. Roialte...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: *sigh* Come now, young man, chin up. Having nice chats with the ladies and gentlemen of Natlan is better than sitting in the office pushing papers, surely?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Surely so, sir. But every document has its final full stop. I can't say the same for this work...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Now, now, don't fret. Work always ends when it should.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Going to continue your exploration of business development opportunities?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Aha! There you are. Our journey through Natlan may now continue.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: #I hope you've been in good health, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You look a little off your game, Iaune...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: He simply needs time to adapt. It's only normal to feel lost when torn so suddenly from one's office desk and one's seals and stamps and schedules.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Anyway, come then! I'd like to hear your thoughts. Which tribe should we visit this time?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The People of the Springs.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Indeed! Let us go, then.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I should've brought a Kamera with me. That way, we could at least have some kind of verifiable record...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: One moment. What does that shop sell? That is an eye-catching sign if I've ever seen one.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Indeed, one could say the same of every one of this tribe's shop signboards. Striking in the extreme.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: The Kamera Club would have a field day here.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Come, let's have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You take Roialte and Iaune up the cliffside path...
